# NCT07221734 
 
Status: RECRUITING | Phase: PHASE3 | Study Type: INTERVENTIONAL | Sponsor: mAbxience Research S.L. 
 
Title: Study to Compare Pharmacokinetics, Efficacy, Safety, and Immunogenicity of MB11 Versus EU-/US-Opdivo® in Subjects With Previously Untreated Advanced [Unresectable or Metastatic] Melanoma 
Target Enrollment: 632 
Eligible Ages: 18 Years to Any age 
Start Date: 2025-12-29 | Completion Date: 2029-02 
Source: ClinicalTrials.gov 
 
## Conditions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- Advanced (Unresectable or Metastatic) Melanoma 
 
## Interventions (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
- MB11 (Proposed Nivolumab Biosimilar) *(DRUG)* 
- EU-Opdivo® *(DRUG)* 
- US- sourced Opdivo® *(DRUG)* 
 
## Summary (ClinicalTrials.gov) 
 
This is a randomised, multicentre, multinational, double-blind, integrated study to sompare the pharmacokinetics, efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of MB11 versus Opdivo® in subjects with previously untreated advanced (unresectable or Metastatic) Melanoma
